title: Mount Kessler Rising
author: August Underhill
blurb: Kestrel Halloran, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
